name: Friedel-Crafts acylation
notes: Acylium substitution gives an aryl ketone without carbocation rearrangement.

name: Friedel-Crafts alkylation
notes: Carbocation rearrangement and polyalkylation may occur; strongly deactivated rings do not react.

name: Electrophilic aromatic nitration
notes: The nitronium ion substitutes an aromatic hydrogen; substituents control regioselectivity.

name: Electrophilic aromatic bromination
notes: Lewis-acid activation of bromine enables electrophilic aromatic substitution.

name: Electrophilic aromatic chlorination
notes: The ring undergoes electrophilic chlorination with regiochemistry set by existing substituents.

name: Electrophilic aromatic sulfonation
notes: Sulfonation is reversible; hot dilute acid can remove the sulfonic acid group.

name: Gattermann-Koch formylation
notes: Introduces a formyl group onto activated aromatic rings.
